component_repair.rejected_full_atlas_prompt:
Precise game sprite atlas repair. Keep exact actor, camera, palette, outfit, weapon and animation phases; true transparent RGBA. This4column12row48sprite atlas has THREE accidental connections between distinct sprites. Separate them by redrawing complete individual sprites slightly smaller/repositioned within their own row, leaving clear transparent gutters:
1) row6 column2 falling LEFT-facing corpse and row7 column2 RIGHT-facing raised-sword attack touch vertically. Complete both sprites, move them apart.
2) row9 column2 RIGHT-facing falling corpse and row10 column2 UP-facing raised-sword attack touch vertically. Complete both, move them apart.
3) row12 columns3and4 two UP-direction final corpse sprites touch sideways. Complete both corpses and swords as distinct objects with transparent gap.
ALL48sprites must be separately isolated bodies, not connected to any neighbor. Do not merely erase limbs, feet, weapons or cloak to make gaps; redraw complete forms, preserve anatomy and equipment. Keep rest unchanged. No visible grid, no labels or background. FOUR columns TWELVE rows, four action phases each row,48whole sprites.

calibration.application: Apply whole sprite around retained contact anchor before common atlas scale. Full swords and cloak remain present. No source file changes.
